title: Pure Nephthys
summary: Pure Nephthys Ritual and Link self-destruction build, supported by generic Ritual searchers. Nephthys monsters destroy cards in your own hand or field to search, revive, and pop opposing cards, triggering delayed Standby Phase revivals and climbing into a 4800 ATK untargetable Nephthys, the Sacred Flame.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds Rebirth of Nephthys along with either Devotee of Nephthys or Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys from your Deck or GY to your hand.

Preparation of Rites searches Level 2 Ritual Monsters Conductor of Nephthys or Devotee of Nephthys and recovers Rebirth of Nephthys from the GY; Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands searches any missing Ritual piece on Normal Summon.
Disciple of Nephthys destroys 1 card in your hand during the Main Phase to search any Nephthys monster except itself from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Conductor of Nephthys + Rebirth of Nephthys
steps: Activate Rebirth of Nephthys by tributing a Level 2+ monster (such as Devotee of Nephthys or Disciple of Nephthys) to Ritual Summon Conductor of Nephthys.

Conductor of Nephthys immediately Special Summons Devotee of Nephthys (or Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys) directly from the hand or Deck, treated as a Ritual Summon; Devotee then Special Summons Disciple or Chronicler of Nephthys from the Deck.

Link Summon Nephthys, the Sacred Preserver to search Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys or Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys and recover Rebirth of Nephthys, Ritual Summon a third Ritual Monster (or revive Devotee from the GY by destroying a Nephthys card in hand), and Link Summon Nephthys, the Sacred Flame using 3 Ritual Monsters.

summary.title: Self-Destruction & Standby Phase Recursion
summary.text: Nephthys effects destroy cards in your own hand or field rather than discarding them, triggering Delayed Standby Phase effects on the next turn: Disciple of Nephthys searches a Nephthys Spell/Trap, Chronicler of Nephthys recovers a Nephthys card from the GY, Conductor of Nephthys destroys another Nephthys card from the Deck, Cerulean Sacred Phoenix revives itself, and the original Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys revives itself and wipes all Spells and Traps on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Nephthys, the Sacred Flame (Link-3) gains effects based on the number of Ritual Monsters used as its Link Material: with 1+, it cannot be destroyed by battle; with 2+, it gains 1200 ATK (to 3600) and cannot be destroyed by card effects; with 3, it gains another 1200 ATK (to 4800 ATK) and cannot be targeted by card effects.

Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys destroys any number of Nephthys cards in your hand and/or face-up field to destroy an equal number of monsters the opponent controls, and revives itself in the next Standby Phase if destroyed by battle or card effect.

Chaos Nephthys Special Summons itself from the hand or GY whenever a card on the field is destroyed by a card effect (by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from your GY) to banish 1 card your opponent controls and 2 cards from their GY.
Herald of Mirage Lights negates a Spell or Trap by discarding a Fairy, and Dyna Mondo spins a card on the field while reviving a Ritual Monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rebirth of Nephthys Ritual Summons any Nephthys Ritual Monster, and if you tributed Devotee of Nephthys or Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys, it also destroys 1 card on the field without targeting.
Last Hope of Nephthys destroys 1 other Nephthys card you control to destroy 1 card the opponent controls, triggering your destruction payoffs on demand.
Awakening of Nephthys boosts all Nephthys monsters by 300 ATK and Special Summons a Winged Beast or Spellcaster from your hand, Deck, or GY if destroyed.

main: Conductor of Nephthys

Core Level 2 WIND Spellcaster Ritual starter: when Ritual Summoned, immediately Special Summons 1 'Nephthys' Ritual Monster directly from your hand or Deck; if Tributed or destroyed by a Nephthys effect, destroys 1 Nephthys card during the next Standby Phase!
Devotee of Nephthys
Core Level 2 FIRE Winged Beast Ritual starter: when Ritual Summoned, Special Summons 1 'Nephthys' monster from your Deck; and destroys 1 Nephthys card in your hand to revive itself from the GY!
Cerulean Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys

Signature Level 8 FIRE Winged Beast Ritual boss (3000 ATK): destroys any number of Nephthys cards in your hand/field to destroy an equal number of monsters your opponent controls; revives itself during the next Standby Phase if destroyed!
Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
Iconic Level 8 FIRE Winged Beast boss (2400 ATK): if destroyed by card effect, Special Summons itself from GY during your next Standby Phase and destroys ALL Spell and Trap Cards on the field!
Disciple of Nephthys

Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: destroys 1 card in your hand during your Main Phase to search any 'Nephthys' monster from your Deck, and searches a Nephthys Spell/Trap during the next Standby Phase if destroyed.
Chronicler of Nephthys
Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: targets 1 'Nephthys' card in your GY, destroys 1 card in your hand, and adds that target to your hand; recovers a Nephthys card during the next Standby Phase if destroyed.
Matriarch of Nephthys
Level 2 WIND Spellcaster: destroys 1 card in hand to revive a Level 4 or lower Nephthys monster from your GY.
Chaos Nephthys

Level 8 DARK Winged Beast boss: Special Summons itself from hand or GY when a card on the field is destroyed by card effect by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK, then banishes 1 card your opponent controls and 2 from their GY!
Rebirth of Nephthys

Core Ritual Spell: tributes monsters from hand or field to Ritual Summon any 'Nephthys' Ritual Monster; and if you Tributed 'Devotee' or 'Cerulean', you can also destroy 1 card on the field WITHOUT targeting!
